episode.subject: Lycogala slime mold
episode.title: A poor reception
episode.body: While I was still pink, a slug came straight toward me. I began to think of something welcoming to say. She stopped, tasted the wood beside me, and turned away. I spent the afternoon being offended on behalf of the log.

Tasted describes invented brief oral investigation without a food or digestive claim. Female pronoun is literary. No actual slime-mold sense organs, walking or literal speech asserted.

proposals.proseAssessment: Actual41-word body written and assessed after inspecting exact image. Oona prepares to welcome an approaching creature, then displaces her disappointment onto the log when the visitor stops nearby and leaves. Offense on behalf of the substrate exposes her own wish to be noticed without explaining it. Distinct from earlier flattening/crowding, identification debate, cold-rain outburst, crack-side crush and mutual aging. The vulnerability is small and comic, not a predation joke. Root should judge whether the projection earns its brief ending.
